skillFull: Writes love letters at certain intervals. Failed letters are thrown away to destroy obstacles, creating Cotton Candy Jellies. After five attempts, Cotton Candy Cookie writes a love letter successfully and calls upon a Post Pigeon to help her fly and deliver the letter to a postbox. Once the letter is placed in the postbox, the Post Pigeon leaves behind a Loving Heart Jelly. Level Up for more points for Cotton Candy Jellies and Loving Heart Jellies.
story:
Cotton Candy Cookie is made from the sweetest of sugars and undoubtedly has the highest level of sugar among the Cookies. With such a saccharine heart, no wonder she's always in love!

Cotton Candy Cookie spends all her days writing love letters but ends up throwing away more than she sends. Her goal is not to reveal her feelings to her beloved one but to cherish each moment of being in love.

Cookies often joke that Cotton Candy Cookie sends way too many letters, but the truth is that everyone secretly wishes for one: what's inside the envelope is so very sweet!

costumes.info: Cotton Candy Cookie always gives her best when it comes to sharing her heart. This Chuseok, she has decided to help other Cookies deliver their messages, especially those who struggle to express their feelings! Anyone who is unable to visit home for the holidays can ask her for a rainbow rice cake scroll to write a message, and she'll wait by the village gate to make sure it's delivered to the right Cookie. Thank you, Cotton Candy Cookie, for make sure these precious letters reach their destination...!
